citation: Positive Airway Pressure Titration Task Force of the American Academy of Sleep Medicine. Clinical guidelines for the manual titration of positive airway pressure in patients with obstructive sleep apnea. J Clin Sleep Med. 2008;4(2):157-171.
currencyNote: AASM continues to list Manual Titration of Positive Airway Pressure in OSA in its active practice-guideline index when verified 2026-08-08. Because this source is older, current AASM Scoring Manual rules and newer applicable PAP/CSA treatment guidance must control when newer requirements differ.
bestFor: Manual CPAP/BPAP titration framework, pre-titration education/acclimatization, event-driven pressure adjustment concepts, treatment-response assessment, titration quality, and the supplemental-oxygen procedure specifically described for PAP titration.

mappingRationale.D4A: Directly addresses manual PAP administration and titration during attended PSG.
mappingRationale.D4C: Contains the active AASM manual-PAP-titration supplemental-oxygen section used for oxygen added during PAP titration. Do not generalize that PAP-specific algorithm to other oxygen indications.

authorityBoundary: Use the supplemental-oxygen section only in the context of manual PAP titration for OSA. It is not a universal oxygen protocol for standalone ordered oxygen, CSA treatment, hypoventilation, pediatric/infant care, or other indications. Current AASM treatment guidance, physician orders, facility policy, professional scope, and manufacturer instructions control where applicable.
copyrightUse: Use citation, high-level guideline topics, section identity, original summaries, and learning objectives. Do not reproduce substantial titration algorithms, pressure tables, or recommendation wording.
